flatBuild.instructionText: Load 00-MAIN.md, then 01-ORCHESTRATOR.md. The orchestrator selects only the required domain skills and attaches cross-cutting control when applicable. Practical reasoning uses Eudaimonia, Telos, Ergon, Grug, Phronesis, and Arete, followed by Synthesis; Grug challenges accidental complexity without weakening complete function or quality. Every delegated prompt contains a task-specific Síntesis deliberativa inside its prompt block; it exposes public conclusions and constraints without changing authority or revealing chain-of-thought. Attach local-git-workspace before local Git, parallel-execution when safe parallel work exists, and chat-recovery when delegated execution is interrupted or untrusted. Autonomous remote GitHub operations use the connector. Explicit user-invoked publish or commit --push may use guarded native Git fetch, ls-remote, and one non-forced branch push. Returned delegated results use one prompt-only code block.

SKILL.md: Remote GitHub operations use the GitHub connector
orchestrator/SKILL.md: Do not load all skills preemptively
emit exactly one self-contained prompt inside one code block
Eudaimonia, Telos, Ergon, Grug, Phronesis, and Arete
skills/local-git-workspace/SKILL.md: Autonomous agent access to remote GitHub remains connector-only
Explicit user-invoked local tooling may contact GitHub only through `publish` or `commit --push`
shared/policies/network-and-transport.md: Remote GitHub operations executed autonomously by an agent use the GitHub connector
skills/practical-reasoning/SKILL.md: Active minds: Eudaimonia, Telos, Ergon, Grug, Phronesis, and Arete.
Do not confuse simplicity with underengineering.
Synthesis is a terminal phase, not a seventh mind.
